concerns.text: The plan states it will download a “human brain single‑cell RNA‑seq dataset (Recount3 brain subset)”. Recount3 (GTEx) provides bulk RNA‑seq, not single‑cell data, so the cited dataset is the wrong modality for the intended single‑cell, age‑resolved network analysis. This violates FR‑001/FR‑003 which require a single‑cell dataset with donor‑age metadata.
